title: Peer Support: Strengthening Resilience in Military Life
intro: Military life isn't just action scenes and hero moments. Whether a Marine is fresh out of boot camp or years into service, frequent moves, high-pressure environments, and time away from home can take a significant mental and emotional toll. The important thing to remember is that no one faces these challenges alone.

sections.heading: OSCAR Teams: Support From Marines, For Marines
sections.markdown: [Operational Stress Control and Readiness](https://www.manpower.marines.mil/Divisions/Marine-and-Family-Programs/Behavioral-Programs) (OSCAR) Teams deliver peer support directly within Marine units and workplaces. Built on trust, these teams watch for signs of stress and step in early. With OSCAR Teams, Marines never manage challenges alone – their team has their six.

sections.heading: Marine for Life Network: Career and Life Support
sections.markdown: The [Marine for Life Network](https://usmc-mccs.org/m4ln) (M4LN) connects transitioning Marines, family members, and veterans with educational resources, employment opportunities, and services that support long-term career and life goals. M4LN representatives are fellow Marines committed to helping others expand their networks and access to support.

sections.heading: Additional Peer Support Resources
sections.markdown:
Many other military and veteran organizations provide meaningful peer support, including:

* [_Vets4Warriors:_](https://vets4warriors.com/) A 24/7 support network staffed entirely by veterans, offering phone, text, and chat support.
* [_Military Veteran Peer Support:_](https://www.hopeforthewarriors.org/programs/social-support-community-connection/military-veteran-peer-support/) Provides counselors and mentors with military backgrounds on bases and in youth centers, ensuring support is accessible and stigma-free.
* [_Modern Military Association:_](https://modernmilitary.org/mental-health-resources/) Promotes inclusive, bias-free spaces where all service members and families feel supported.

sections.heading: The Impact of Peer Support
sections.markdown: Peer support reduces stigma, strengthens resilience, and reinforces the understanding that seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness. Often, the most powerful support comes from someone who has walked a similar path.

sections.heading: Bottom line:
sections.markdown: Regardless of age, rank, or experience, Marines and their families are never alone. Peer support programs are available across the country – built on the belief that in the military, everyone looks out for one another through every challenge.
